parts.zh: 佛罗里达州一名青少年和亚特兰大一名女性在周六的年度七英里大桥跑比赛中分别赢得男子组和女子组总冠军
M: 嗯……我不知道这是不是个好主意
W: 其实我不会一个人住
M: 你确定吗?大城市的房租很高
W: 我们已经把这些都做了预算
M: 那往返学校怎么办?听起来你每天要在路上浪费好几个小时
W: 到学校大约一小时
M: 这倒是真的。但我不明白既然费用一样
W: 原因有很多。我们会有厨房
M: 我还不确定好处是否大于坏处
W: 哦,对。我们小时候就有一套

items.stem: What does the news report say about Vaclav Bursa and Joanna Stephens?

choices.text: They are young teenagers from Atlanta.
choices.zh: 他们是来自亚特兰大的青少年。

choices.text: They won this year's 7 Mile Bridge Run.
choices.zh: 他们赢得了今年的7英里桥梁跑比赛。

choices.text: They completed the race in less than 40 minutes.
choices.zh: 他们在不到40分钟内完成了比赛。

choices.text: They are both students at Marathon High School.
choices.zh: 他们都是Marathon高中的学生。

items.stem: What do we learn about the April contest?

choices.text: It drew competitors from more than 40 countries.
choices.zh: 它吸引了来自40多个国家的参赛者。

choices.text: It is watched live online by fans all over the world.
choices.zh: 它被全世界的粉丝在线观看直播。

choices.text: It closed the city of Big Pine Key to traffic for three hours.
choices.zh: 它使Big Pine Key市封闭交通三小时。

choices.text: It is one of the most popular running events in the southeastern U.S.
choices.zh: 它是美国东南部最受欢迎的跑步赛事之一。

items.stem: What do we learn from the news report about Tim Peake?

choices.text: He was once a full-time ambassador.
choices.zh: 他曾经是一名全职大使。

choices.text: He was soon to retire from the army.
choices.zh: 他即将从军队退役。

choices.text: He became an astronaut in 2015.
choices.zh: 他在2015年成为一名宇航员。

choices.text: He used to be a helicopter pilot.
choices.zh: 他曾经是一名直升机飞行员。

items.stem: What does Tim Peake say about his work with the European Space Agency?

choices.text: It has been unbelievably exciting and rewarding.
choices.zh: 令人难以置信地激动人心且有意义。

choices.text: It has been extraordinarily tough and demanding.
choices.zh: 异常艰苦且要求严格。

choices.text: It has contributed a great deal to human flights to space.
choices.zh: 对人类太空飞行做出了巨大贡献。

choices.text: It has given him exceptional privilege as an ambassador.
choices.zh: 作为大使赋予了他特殊的荣誉。

items.stem: What do we learn about the five cats seen in the Asda store?

choices.text: They are known for their loyalty to their owners.
choices.zh: 它们以对主人的忠诚而闻名。

choices.text: They are brought in by the store's customers.
choices.zh: 它们是由商店的顾客带进来的。

choices.text: They are regular visitors to the store.
choices.zh: 它们是商店的常客。

choices.text: They are pets kept by the store staff.
choices.zh: 它们是商店员工饲养的宠物。

items.stem: What did some customers think when they saw the first cat routinely appear in the store?

choices.text: It might be a nuisance to the loyal shoppers.
choices.zh: 它可能会给忠实顾客带来麻烦。

choices.text: It might have been abandoned by its owner.
choices.zh: 它可能被主人遗弃了。

choices.text: It might be 12 months old.
choices.zh: 它可能有12个月大。

choices.text: It might have got lost.
choices.zh: 它可能迷路了。

items.stem: What are customers asked not to do?

choices.text: Feed the cats.
choices.zh: 喂猫。

choices.text: Remove any store signs.
choices.zh: 移除任何商店标识。

choices.text: Sit in the shop aisles.
choices.zh: 坐在商店过道里。

choices.text: Bring in pets with them.
choices.zh: 随身带宠物进来。

items.stem: What has the woman been thinking of doing next semester?

choices.text: Sharing her room with friends.
choices.zh: 与朋友合住一个房间。

choices.text: Cutting down her living expenses.
choices.zh: 削减她的生活开支。

choices.text: Living off campus.
choices.zh: 住在校外。

choices.text: Moving to the city center.
choices.zh: 搬到市中心。

items.stem: What does the man suggest the woman take into consideration?

choices.text: The facilities available.
choices.zh: 可用的设施。

choices.text: Various costs involved.
choices.zh: 涉及的各种费用。

choices.text: Changes in living conditions.
choices.zh: 生活条件的变化。

choices.text: The distance to her home.
choices.zh: 到她家的距离。

items.stem: What does the woman say she did during high school?

choices.text: Went through much trouble.
choices.zh: 经历了很多麻烦。

choices.text: Commuted to save money.
choices.zh: 通勤以省钱。

choices.text: Studied on the bus.
choices.zh: 在公交车上学习。

choices.text: Lived on campus.
choices.zh: 住在校园里。

items.stem: What does the man say he'll do at the end of the conversation?

choices.text: Discuss the matter with the woman's mother.
choices.zh: 与这位女士的母亲讨论这件事。

choices.text: Make a decision within a few days.
choices.zh: 在几天内做出决定。

choices.text: Try his best to persuade his wife.
choices.zh: 尽力说服他的妻子。

choices.text: Weigh the benefits against the disadvantages.
choices.zh: 权衡利弊。

items.stem: What is the woman doing?

choices.text: Interviewing the man.
choices.zh: 正在面试这位男士。

choices.text: Looking for Lawrence.
choices.zh: 正在寻找Lawrence。

choices.text: Choosing a present for her nephew.
choices.zh: 正在为她的侄子挑选礼物。

choices.text: Helping the man with his shopping.
choices.zh: 正在帮这位男士购物。

items.stem: How does the man describe Bobo Man, the action figure?

choices.text: Quite educational.
choices.zh: 相当有教育意义。

choices.text: Incredibly popular.
choices.zh: 非常受欢迎。

choices.text: Driven by batteries.
choices.zh: 由电池驱动。

choices.text: Obviously childish.
choices.zh: 明显很幼稚。

items.stem: What kind of game does the woman think would be good for Lawrence?

choices.text: One he loves for helping exercise his mind.
choices.zh: 一个他喜欢的有助于锻炼思维的游戏。

choices.text: One he can play together with his sister.
choices.zh: 一个他可以和妹妹一起玩的游戏。

choices.text: One he finds interesting and challenging.
choices.zh: 一个他觉得有趣且有挑战性的游戏。

choices.text: One he can play either alone or in a group.
choices.zh: 一个他可以单独玩或集体玩的游戏。

items.stem: What do we learn from the conversation about the game Battleships?

choices.text: It has been enjoyed by kids for decades.
choices.zh: 几十年来一直深受孩子们喜爱。

choices.text: It always reminds people of times of war.
choices.zh: 总是让人想起战争时期。

choices.text: It has been played both indoors and outdoors.
choices.zh: 既可以在室内玩也可以在室外玩。

choices.text: It distinguishes itself as one of the oldest games.
choices.zh: 作为最古老的游戏之一而与众不同。

items.stem: What do we learn from the passage about the paradox of choice?

choices.text: A display of a variety of products increases consumers' interest.
choices.zh: 多种产品的陈列会增加消费者的兴趣。

choices.text: Too many choices decrease one's desire to buy.
choices.zh: 过多的选择会降低购买欲望。

choices.text: Fewer choices lead to lower customer satisfaction.
choices.zh: 较少的选择会导致较低的顾客满意度。

choices.text: Customers given more choices are more likely to get confused.
choices.zh: 给予顾客更多选择更有可能使其感到困惑。

items.stem: What did the psychologists want to find out in their 2012 study about jams?

choices.text: What kind of display results in more sales.
choices.zh: 什么样的陈列方式会带来更多销售额。

choices.text: What kind of display creates more interest.
choices.zh: 什么样的陈列方式会产生更多兴趣。

choices.text: What kind of display attracts a greater crowd of customers.
choices.zh: 什么样的陈列方式会吸引更多顾客。

choices.text: What kind of display leads to greater customer satisfaction.
choices.zh: 什么样的陈列方式会带来更高的顾客满意度。

items.stem: What is the finding of an extensive study published in 2015?

choices.text: There are situations where customers buy nothing.
choices.zh: 存在顾客什么都不买的情况。

choices.text: There are tricks to increase customer satisfaction.
choices.zh: 存在提高顾客满意度的技巧。

choices.text: There are ways to predict customer preferences.
choices.zh: 存在预测顾客偏好的方法。

choices.text: There are rules that motivate customers to buy.
choices.zh: 存在激励顾客购买的规律。

items.stem: What do many Americans think of volunteering?

choices.text: Stressful.
choices.zh: 有压力的。

choices.text: Burdensome.
choices.zh: 繁重的。

choices.text: Worthwhile.
choices.zh: 值得的。

choices.text: Energy-boosting.
choices.zh: 提升精力的。

items.stem: How could companies ensure both employees and employers benefit from volunteering?

choices.text: By linking it with employees' salary.
choices.zh: 将其与员工的薪水挂钩。

choices.text: By taking it as the New Year resolution.
choices.zh: 将其作为新年决心。

choices.text: By improving work schedules.
choices.zh: 改善工作日程安排。

choices.text: By making it part of the job.
choices.zh: 使其成为工作的一部分。

items.stem: What did 75% of employees say about volunteering in a survey?

choices.text: It was very important to their well-being.
choices.zh: 它对他们的幸福感非常重要。

choices.text: It had taken little of their spare time.
choices.zh: 它几乎没有占用他们的业余时间。

choices.text: It was an outlet for their personal fulfillment.
choices.zh: 它是他们实现个人价值的途径。

choices.text: It helped improve their working environment.
choices.zh: 它有助于改善他们的工作环境。

items.stem: What do we learn about the UK's retail sector food waste?

choices.text: It amounts to 2,000 tons daily.
choices.zh: 它每天达到2000吨。

choices.text: It mostly comes from supermarkets.
choices.zh: 它主要来自超市。

choices.text: It is estimated at 11% of the UK's total food supply.
choices.zh: 它估计占英国食品供应总量的11%。

choices.text: It has a lot to do with independent luxury food suppliers.
choices.zh: 它与独立的奢侈食品供应商有很大关系。

items.stem: What does Sophie André's business do in London?

choices.text: It rents bicycles to deliver food.
choices.zh: 它出租自行车来配送食品。

choices.text: It sells sought-after coffee beans.
choices.zh: 它销售抢手的咖啡豆。

choices.text: It delivers luxury hand-made food.
choices.zh: 它配送奢侈的手工制作食品。

choices.text: It recycles waste food from the city.
choices.zh: 它回收利用来自城市的废弃食品。

items.stem: In what way does Sophie André's business differ from many food waste projects?

choices.text: It pays special attention to the size and shape of its products.
choices.zh: 它特别关注其产品的大小和形状。

choices.text: It tries to escape the constraints of the current food system.
choices.zh: 它试图摆脱当前食品系统的限制。

choices.text: It cooperates closely with local producers.
choices.zh: 它与当地生产商密切合作。

choices.text: It aims to provide high-quality products.
choices.zh: 它旨在提供高质量的产品。

items.stem: Why will suppliers always have a certain amount of surplus?

choices.text: To ensure a regular supply.
choices.zh: 为了确保有规律的供应。

choices.text: To maintain a unique menu.
choices.zh: 为了保持独特的菜单。

choices.text: To make up for the waste products.
choices.zh: 为了弥补废弃产品。

choices.text: To meet customers' urgent demand.
choices.zh: 为了满足顾客的紧急需求。
